name: @eduzone/security-tests
description: Fast, Docker-free RLS + permission regression tests (fast-gate-*.ts), run against the disposable local Postgres harness in local-test-harness/. Complementary to the deeper, Docker/live-Supabase-based rls-smoke-test.ts + permission-exhaustive-test.ts, which stay wired into .github/workflows/e2e.yml. Not part of the app build or the pnpm workspace.
